facts.fact: Uganda Police forensic services director Andrew Mubiru said on 2026-08-12 that Uganda has not ratified the Malabo Convention, and that solution providers ask about ratification when Uganda seeks forensic tools.
facts.system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection

facts.fact: Mubiru said Uganda needs to domesticate the Malabo Convention, so it has not been taken into national law; the article is dated 2026-08-12 and gives no other date for this.
facts.system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection
